messages.subject: SPDE- Error
parts:
Dear group,
I  have been getting an error whenever i run a spatio-temporal model with Gamma likelihood which i attribute to perhaps inadequate information on how INLA and in particular spde operates.  Here is the error;


"This application has requested the Runtime to terminate it in an unusual way.
 Please, contact the application's support for more information "

Previously, i would be told that INLA has crashed but this was before i added "silent=2"  in the model. Many thanks indeed.

Erick.
